The solver is DETERMINISTIC: a single zero-shot forward pass with frozen weights and no sampling -> iter-5, iter-7, AND iter-8 all reproduced val_score 0.9070974588394165 BIT-IDENTICALLY, so a seed read does NOTHING. (2) LIMITER: foreign-prior FBP-ceiling on dense Mayo. RAM is a frozen pretrained zero-shot deepinv foundation-model denoiser that never saw real LDCT helical-rebinned 2304-view fan data; on dense full-view Mayo LD-FBP is already a near-complete inversion, so a foreign-prior denoiser can only redistribute/smooth signal, not add LDCT-specific recoverable structure -> RMSE stays above the LD-FBP floor (~31-33dB PSNR below the floor) -> calibrated headroom pinned at 0.0 (baseline LD-FBP SSIM 0.8078, oracle HD-FBP SSIM 0.9331; best RAM SSIM 0.9071 is below the LD-FBP floor on the RMSE-sensitive metric). (3) ONE KNOB: NONE genuinely-untried in-budget exists -- empty patch {} on BASE_ITER=5. Audited: ram_disable_multiscale True->False re-enables per-scale physics evals across 214 slices, pushing the already-985s path over the 1200s wall WITHOUT being a quality lever; ram_clamp_output True->False is degenerate on an RMSE-sensitive metric (unclamping can only let pixels drift = neutral-or-worse, non-diagnostic); no seed lever (deterministic, proven bit-identical); ram_finetune budget-infeasible. So the honest call is the empty-patch CONFIRMATION re-running the best inference point. (4) HYPOTHESIS: hr stays EXACTLY 0.0 at SSIM 0.9070974588394165 (bit-identical determinism). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if this re-run lands hr != 0.0 OR SSIM != 0.9070974588394165, the iter-5/7/8 reads were NOT stable (non-determinism in the zero-shot path) and the ceiling read must be re-audited; otherwise the FBP-bound ceiling is confirmed for the 4th time and the finetune lever is retired as budget-infeasible (NOT a negative architectural result). (5) SIZE/BUDGET <=1200s: INFERENCE-ONLY (ram_finetune=False), IDENTICAL compute profile to iter-5/7/8 (985.9s/989.8s/970.4s = 16-16.4 min, ~4.6s/slice x 214 single forward passes + one op-norm power iter), comfortably under the HARD 1200s=20-min budget; ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False avoids extra deepinv-tomo physics evals; ZERO finetune cost (finetune OFF). sbatch --time=00:30:00 backstop wall (no in-solver wall knob in solver_ram.py). val=ALL 214 L277 slices. (6) no control return. HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geom, per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe, val-only solver), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV DEFAULT (no fov=False).
